newsitem.title: USA: Diana names Fiedler as chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Diana names Fiedler as chairman, CEO.

text.p: Diana Corp said Thursday that it named James Fiedler, who is now chairman and chief executive officer of its Sattel Communications Inc business, to the additional posts of chairman and chief executive of Diana, effective November 29.
Fiedler is also a member of Diana's board.
At that time, Daniel Latham, president and chief operating officer of Sattel, will assume the additional posts of president, chief operating officer and director of Diana.
Richard Fiedler has been chairman and chief executive officer of Diana Corp.
Earlier, Diana announced plans to split into two publicly traded entities. Diana will retain its Sattel Communications Inc business and will rename itself Sattel.

The remaining businesses, Atlanta Provision Co Inc, C&L Communications Inc and Valley Communications Inc, will be grouped together and will trade on the Nasdaq. In its statement, Diana referred to these businesses as "NEWCO."
Diana said Fisher will assist Fiedler and Latham by overseeing the NEWCO operations during the transition period.

Fisher is expected to be appointed chairman and chief executive officer of NEWCO after the companies are split. After the split, no individuals will serve as officers or directors of both Sattel and NEWCO.

"The marketplace will now be able to value our business as an independent company, which will enhance our ability to attract capital to fund our business strategy," Fiedler said. "I believe that we owe a debt of gratitude to Dick Fisher for his vision, his contributions, and his willingness to take the bold actions necessary to complete the restructuring."
A proxy statement will be filed with the Securities and Exchange commission and a special shareholders meeting will be held later.
Diana said it will move its executive offices to Sattel's headquarters in Calabasas, Calif. NEWCO's headquarters will be located in Milwaukee, Wis.
